name: Romania

authorities.competent_authority: ANMDMR (National Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices of Romania) coordinates the national procedure and communicates the final decision through CTIS.
authorities.ethics: CNBMDM (National Bioethics Committee for Medicines and Medical Devices) performs the ethical assessment: participant information and consent, recruitment, investigator and site suitability, insurance, compensation and financial arrangements.
authorities.fee: Order 3390/2022 includes a Romanian payment commitment form for ANMDMR invoices, required where the national process requests it (RO-FEE, CTIS Forms section). Check the current ANMDMR clinical-trials pages before submission; the guides give no amounts.
authorities.legal_basis: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014; Government Emergency Ordinance 29/2022; Ministry of Health Order 3390/2022 (Annexes 1 to 10, national Part II forms); CNBMDM Regulation (Ministry of Health Order 80/2023).

language_rules.rule: Documents intended for participants in Romania, including recruitment materials, must be in Romanian. Government Emergency Ordinance 29/2022 allows documentation not intended for participants to be submitted in English.
language_rules.non_romanian_speakers: If people who do not speak Romanian may be enrolled, K1 explains how valid informed consent will be obtained; plan translated information and consent documents for any such population the protocol and sites are expected to enrol.
language_rules.form_answers: Part II forms (shared EU templates in content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Romanian, matching the CTIS_RO variable sheet; English is also permitted for these non-participant documents (DECISIONS.md D1).

study_facts_note: Country-specific keys: population.non_romanian_speakers (the planning playbook's non-local-language speakers), recruitment.electronic_resources (prior CNBMDM approval), trial.phase_1_or_bioequivalence (ANMDMR unit authorisation), fee.payment_commitment_requested (national payment commitment form).

documents.name_en: Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, one set per population
documents.language_note: Romanian for Romanian participants. Add translated sets (L1_SIS and ICF_<population>_RO_<language code>) for any non-Romanian-speaking population the protocol and sites are expected to enrol.
documents.signature_rule: Submitted blank. Signed and dated at consent by the participant or legally designated representative and by the physician who conducts the consent interview; the impartial witness also signs and dates where that pathway applies; for an adult lacking capacity who can form an opinion and assess the information, both the participant and the representative sign the consent form (Order 3390/2022).
documents.content: Blank Romanian information sheet and consent form for each population that can enter the trial. Conditional separate or adapted documents for minors, adults lacking capacity, emergency enrolment, participants unable to write, pregnancy follow-up and optional future research: see population_sets.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea L. Obligatoriu: un set de informare și consimțământ pentru fiecare populație. În limba română pentru participanții din România (documentele destinate participanților nu sunt acoperite de excepția OUG 29/2022 privind limba engleză). Se depune necompletat și nesemnat; se semnează și se datează la obținerea consimțământului de participant sau de reprezentantul desemnat legal și de medicul care realizează interviul. Interviul pentru consimțământ este realizat de un medic membru al echipei de investigație, instruit corespunzător privind protocolul și buna practică în studiul clinic (Ordinul 3390/2022). Documente separate sau adaptate pentru minori, adulți fără capacitate, înrolare în urgență, participanți care nu pot scrie, urmărirea sarcinii și cercetare viitoare opțională (vezi population_sets). Dacă se înrolează persoane care nu vorbesc limba română, planificați documente traduse.

template.basis: EudraLex Volume 10 recruitment and informed-consent procedure template, version 2.0 (full implementation from 1 September 2026). Replaces, for new Part II submissions, the May 2022 national form 'RO_Procedura de recrutare şi obţinere a consimţământului informat' in Order 3390/2022 (Annex 3); check the current ANMDMR form immediately before filing.

documents.content: How potential participants are identified, approached and informed; who obtains consent, when and where; privacy and decision time; how understanding is checked; how non-Romanian speakers are handled; how withdrawal is managed; how responses to recruitment material are handled and what happens when a person does not qualify. Complete the sections for adults lacking capacity, minors, impartial witness and emergency wherever the population or pathway applies. Describe the process actually planned at Romanian sites, not generic wording.

national_fields.v105: Romania: electronic recruitment resources require prior CNBMDM approval; describe how responses are managed and what happens when a potential participant does not qualify; where potential participants are identified from medical records or other sources, explain how access to identifying data complies with applicable rules and Union data-protection law.
national_fields.v108: Romania: the person conducting the consent interview is a physician, member of the investigation team and appropriately trained on the protocol and GCP (Order 3390/2022); state when and where consent is taken, how privacy is protected, how much decision time is given and how understanding is checked; for non-Romanian speakers, explain how valid informed consent will be obtained (translated information and consent documents); describe withdrawal handling.
national_fields.v110: Romania: justify recruitment of adults lacking capacity and explain the condition causing the incapacity and its relevance to the trial; state who assesses and confirms capacity; how the legally designated representative is identified, in what capacity they act and how their authority under Romanian law is verified (a relative does not automatically have authority); how information is adapted and the participant involved; where the participant can form an opinion and assess the information, both the participant and the representative sign the informed-consent form (Order 3390/2022); how consent to continued participation is obtained if capacity returns.
national_fields.v114: Romania: consent of the legally designated representative; the minor's agreement is mandatory when the minor can form an opinion and assess the information (Order 3390/2022), with no fixed assent age; parental authority is generally joint and equal, so verify who has legal authority in the individual case; full legal capacity normally begins at 18 (do not build the routine pathway on the Civil Code exceptions); new informed consent before further protocol actions when the participant reaches 18; a paediatrician is part of the investigator team.
national_fields.v117: Romania: explain why an impartial witness is expected to be needed, how the witness is identified and how the site will know that the participant has actually given informed consent; the impartial witness signs and dates the informed-consent document (Order 3390/2022); describe a process that preserves impartiality without inventing national eligibility criteria.
national_fields.v121: Romania: explain why prior consent from the participant or legal representative cannot be obtained; the procedure to obtain informed consent as soon as possible from the participant or representative, whichever can validly give it first; how the study ensures that a known prior objection to participation is respected; data already collected in compliance with Article 35 may remain after a later refusal, with no further research data collected.

documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea K. Obligatoriu. Document administrativ: română sau engleză; răspunsurile în acest formular în limba română. Fără semnătură la depunere. Bază: șablonul UE „Recruitment and informed consent procedure” versiunea 2.0 (implementare completă de la 1 septembrie 2026); formularul național din mai 2022 din Ordinul 3390/2022 (Anexa 3) rămâne publicat, dar Ordinul prevede republicarea formularelor românești la actualizarea șabloanelor Comisiei: verificați formularul ANMDMR curent imediat înainte de depunere. Descrieți procesul real din centrele din România. Interviul de consimțământ: medic membru al echipei de investigație, instruit privind protocolul și GCP. Explicați cum se obține consimțământul valabil pentru persoanele care nu vorbesc limba română. Resursele electronice de recrutare necesită aprobarea prealabilă a CNBMDM; descrieți gestionarea răspunsurilor și a persoanelor neeligibile. Completați secțiunile pentru adulți fără capacitate, minori, martor imparțial și urgență conform câmpurilor naționale de mai jos.

documents.trigger_text: Posters, advertisements, social-media materials, patient-organisation materials or other recruitment content used in Romania.
documents.content: Final Romanian material, consistent with the recruitment procedure (K1) and the participant information. No claims about efficacy, safety or guaranteed benefit beyond the protocol and approved participant information. Electronic recruitment resources require prior CNBMDM approval.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea K. Condiționat: numai dacă se folosesc afișe, anunțuri, materiale pentru rețele sociale, materiale ale organizațiilor de pacienți sau alt conținut de recrutare. În limba română, conform procedurii de recrutare (K1). Fără afirmații privind eficacitatea, siguranța sau un beneficiu garantat dincolo de protocol. Resursele electronice de recrutare necesită aprobarea prealabilă a CNBMDM.

documents.name_en: Principal investigator curriculum vitae (Romanian national CV form)
documents.template_required: Romanian national principal-investigator CV form in Ministry of Health Order 3390/2022 (current version required for the Romanian site; includes relevant clinical-trial experience and training, with date and signature fields). Not in the CTIS_RO folder: its M1 DOCX is the shared EU CV form. Once supplied, convert it into countries/RO/templates/part-ii and change kind to third_party_template (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.signature_rule: The national form contains date and signature fields: completed, dated and signed by the principal investigator before submission when the current national form requires it.
documents.content: Relevant clinical-trial experience and training of the site principal investigator, on the current national form. Where minors are included, the investigator team includes a paediatrician (Order 3390/2022).
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea M. Obligatoriu pentru fiecare investigator principal și centru. Folosiți formularul național de CV din Ordinul 3390/2022, în versiunea curentă cerută pentru centrul din România (experiență relevantă în studii clinice și instruire; câmpuri pentru dată și semnătură). Datat și semnat înainte de depunere atunci când formularul național curent o cere. Română sau engleză. Datele personale sunt furnizate de investigator; asistentul nu inventează date personale. Pentru studii cu populație pediatrică, echipa de investigație include un medic pediatru.

documents.name_en: Principal investigator declaration of interests (Romanian national form)
documents.template_required: Romanian national declaration-of-interests form in Ministry of Health Order 3390/2022. Not in the CTIS_RO folder: its M2 DOCX is the shared EU form. Once supplied, convert it into countries/RO/templates/part-ii and change kind to third_party_template (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.signature_rule: Completed and signed by the principal investigator on the applicable national form before submission.
documents.content: Economic, institutional or personal interests that could affect impartiality, disclosed by the principal investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea M. Obligatoriu pentru fiecare investigator principal și centru. Formularul național de declarație de interese din Ordinul 3390/2022: interese economice, instituționale sau personale care ar putea afecta imparțialitatea. Completat și semnat de investigatorul principal. Română sau engleză. Asistentul nu completează declarațiile de interese și nu inventează date.

template.basis: EU site-suitability template (CTAG). Interim only: Romania's national site-suitability form in Order 3390/2022 is not in the CTIS_RO folder. The EU form collects the content (facilities, equipment, procedures, staff); the upload is the national form.
template.national_model_required: Romanian national site-suitability form in Ministry of Health Order 3390/2022 (facilities, staff, participant numbers, operational capability; three signatures)

documents.signature_rule: Signed before submission by the principal investigator, the head of the relevant department, clinic or section, and the hospital or institution manager.
documents.content: One separate description per Romanian site: facilities, staff, participant numbers and operational capability, specific to this protocol. A paediatrician on the investigator team where minors are included. Phase I or bioequivalence units also need ANMDMR authorisation (RO-N-PHASE1).
documents.note: Until the national form is supplied and converted into countries/RO/templates/part-ii, the EU form only collects the content; it is not the Romanian upload (DECISIONS.md D2).

national_fields.n1_issued_by: Romania requires signatures at submission: leave the block empty in the draft; the principal investigator, the head of the department, clinic or section, and the hospital or institution manager sign the final national form before upload.

documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields left empty for the site; signed by the principal investigator, head of department and institution manager
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea N. Obligatoriu, un document separat pentru fiecare centru din România. Forma de depunere este formularul național de adecvare a centrului din Ordinul 3390/2022 (facilități, personal, număr de participanți, capacitate operațională); formularul UE servește doar provizoriu pentru colectarea conținutului și nu se încarcă drept document românesc. Semnat înainte de depunere de investigatorul principal, de șeful secției/clinicii/compartimentului și de managerul spitalului sau al instituției; în proiect blocul de semnătură rămâne gol. Datele centrului (denumire, investigator principal, număr de participanți) rămân necompletate pentru centru. Pentru studii pediatrice, un medic pediatru face parte din echipa de investigație. Unitățile care efectuează studii de fază I sau de bioechivalență necesită autorizarea ANMDMR (vezi RO-N-PHASE1).

documents.ctis_title: N<next number>_ANMDMR Phase I unit authorisation_<site>
documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide gives no fixed code; use the next free N number under suitability of facilities (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.name_en: ANMDMR authorisation of the healthcare unit for Phase I or bioequivalence studies
documents.trigger_text: A Romanian healthcare unit conducts a Phase I or bioequivalence study. Additional national operational requirement for those units (Order 3390/2022, Government Emergency Ordinance 29/2022: facilities, emergency infrastructure, transfer arrangements, staff), not a general requirement for every site.
documents.content: Evidence that the unit holds the relevant ANMDMR authorisation. Confirm it before treating site readiness as complete.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea N. Condiționat: numai pentru unități sanitare care efectuează studii de fază I sau de bioechivalență. Autorizarea ANMDMR a unității, conform Ordinului 3390/2022 și OUG 29/2022 (facilități, infrastructură pentru urgențe, transfer, personal). Cerință operațională națională pentru aceste unități, nu pentru toate centrele. Furnizată de centru; asistentul verifică doar coerența cu N1. Confirmați autorizarea înainte de a considera centrul pregătit.

documents.content: Evidence of insurance or indemnity covering trial-related injury or death, as required under the Clinical Trials Regulation and the applicable Romanian arrangements; evaluated by CNBMDM. The participant information describes the injury and insurance pathway in plain language and matches this evidence.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea O. Obligatoriu. Dovada asigurării sau a mecanismului de despăgubire pentru vătămări sau deces legate de studiu, conform Regulamentului (UE) nr. 536/2014 și aranjamentelor românești aplicabile; evaluată de CNBMDM. Emisă de asigurător; asistentul verifică doar identitatea studiului și concordanța cu informațiile pentru participanți. Ghidurile nu indică sume minime sau o limbă anume; nu completați din alte surse.

template.basis: EU compensation template (CTAG), version 5, June 2023. Interim only: Romania publishes its own national compensation form in Order 3390/2022 (Annex 7, as cited in the supplied templates), not in the CTIS_RO folder. Same content structure (who receives what: travel, accommodation, meals, loss of earnings, cash or non-cash payments; cross-reference to the participant information allowed).
template.national_model_required: Romanian national participant compensation form, Ministry of Health Order 3390/2022 (Annex 7)

documents.signature_note: The guides state no signature rule for this form (DECISIONS.md D9).
documents.content: Whether participants, parents, carers or legal representatives receive reimbursement or compensation for travel, accommodation, meals, loss of earnings, cash or non-cash payments. A cross-reference to the participant information is allowed if it is precise and the amounts or calculation logic agree. For minors, adults lacking capacity and pregnant or breastfeeding participants, no financial inducement beyond expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.
documents.note: Until the national form is supplied and converted into countries/RO/templates/part-ii, the EU form only collects the content; it is not the Romanian upload (DECISIONS.md D2).

national_fields.f02: Romania: a reference to the participant information sheet is allowed instead of repeating the details; cite the exact document, version and section, and make sure the amounts or calculation logic agree.
national_fields.f06: Romania: for minors, adults lacking capacity, their representatives, and pregnant or breastfeeding participants, state that nothing is offered beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.

documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea P. Obligatoriu. Forma de depunere este formularul național de compensare din Ordinul 3390/2022 (Anexa 7); formularul UE servește doar provizoriu pentru colectarea conținutului. Indicați dacă participanții, părinții, însoțitorii sau reprezentanții legali primesc rambursări sau compensații pentru transport, cazare, masă, pierderea veniturilor, plăți în bani sau în natură. Trimiterea la formularul de informare este permisă numai dacă este exactă (document, versiune, secțiune), iar sumele sau modul de calcul coincid. Pentru minori, adulți fără capacitate și reprezentanții lor, precum și pentru femei însărcinate sau care alăptează, nu se oferă stimulente dincolo de compensarea cheltuielilor și a pierderilor de venit direct legate de participare. Română sau engleză.

documents.name_en: Trial financing description and unsigned sponsor-site or sponsor-investigator contract
documents.signature_rule: Submitted unsigned (Order 3390/2022). Do not add signatures merely because other administrative forms require them.
documents.content: Description of trial financing and the general financial arrangements with sites and investigators, reviewed by CNBMDM; the unsigned form of the sponsor-site or sponsor-investigator contract containing the general clauses on payments.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea P. Obligatoriu. Descrierea finanțării studiului și a aranjamentelor financiare generale cu centrele și investigatorii, evaluate de CNBMDM; forma nesemnată a contractului sponsor–centru sau sponsor–investigator, cu clauzele generale privind plățile (Ordinul 3390/2022). Nu adăugați semnături. Furnizat de sponsor; asistentul verifică coerența cu P1 și cu documentele pentru participanți.

documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_RO
documents.name_en: Data-protection compliance declaration (Annex I section R)

template.basis: EudraLex GDPR compliance statement (Annex I section R)

documents.signature_note: The guides state no signature rule; the form's own sponsor name, role and date fields are completed (DECISIONS.md D9).
documents.content: Declaration that personal data will be processed in accordance with Union data-protection law. No national data-protection statement is required by the Romania guides, so r1_the_sponsor_declares is not used. Participant privacy language matches the actual data flow and does not present trial consent as the only legal basis for all processing.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea R. Obligatoriu. Declarația cerută de anexa I secțiunea R din Regulamentul (UE) nr. 536/2014, prin care se confirmă că datele cu caracter personal vor fi prelucrate în conformitate cu legislația Uniunii privind protecția datelor. Ghidurile pentru România nu cer o declarație națională suplimentară: câmpul pentru declarația națională rămâne neaplicabil. Coerență cu fluxul real de date și cu informațiile pentru participanți; consimțământul la studiu nu este prezentat ca singurul temei legal al prelucrării. Română sau engleză.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_RO
documents.name_en: Compliance with collection, storage and future use of biological samples
documents.trigger_text: The trial collects or stores human biological samples.

template.basis: EudraLex biological-samples form. Order 3390/2022 reproduces a biological-sample compliance template (Annex 10, as cited in the supplied templates) that may be used and states that it is not mandatory; the shared EU form covers the same questions (collection, storage, coding, access, transfer, future use, recontact).

national_fields.f03: Romania: secondary future use may require additional ethics review depending on the new purpose; a future project not described in the approved trial documents is not automatically authorised by the original CTIS approval.

documents.drafting_notes_ro: CTIS Partea II, secțiunea S. Condiționat: numai dacă studiul colectează sau păstrează probe biologice umane. Ordinul 3390/2022 reproduce un șablon de conformitate pentru probe biologice (Anexa 10), care poate fi folosit și care nu este obligatoriu; formularul UE comun acoperă aceleași întrebări. Distingeți identificarea directă, codificarea pseudonimizată și probele anonimizate; indicați accesul la probe și la lista de coduri, durata păstrării, transferurile, utilizarea viitoare și dacă donatorul va fi recontactat pentru un nou consimțământ. Utilizarea secundară viitoare poate necesita o nouă evaluare etică. Coerență cu protocolul, planul de laborator, informațiile pentru participanți și documentul separat pentru utilizare secundară. Română sau engleză.

documents.ctis_title_note: Proof of fee payment uses the CTIS Forms section, not a Part II placeholder; the CTCG naming guide gives no title. Provisional title (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.name_en: Romanian payment commitment form for ANMDMR invoices
documents.trigger_text: Mandatory where requested by the national process. Order 3390/2022 includes a Romanian payment commitment form for ANMDMR invoices; check the current ANMDMR clinical-trials pages before submission, because payment administration can change separately from the Part II requirements.
documents.template_required: Romanian payment commitment form in Order 3390/2022; not in the CTIS_RO folder.
documents.signature_note: The guides state no signature rule for this form; follow the current national form.
documents.drafting_notes_ro: Secțiunea Forms din CTIS (dovada plății), nu un document din Partea II. Obligatoriu atunci când procesul național îl solicită: angajamentul de plată românesc pentru facturile ANMDMR din Ordinul 3390/2022. Verificați paginile ANMDMR privind studiile clinice înainte de depunere, deoarece administrarea plăților se poate modifica separat. Furnizat de sponsor; asistentul doar verifică.

population_sets.note: A variation of the main Romanian document; Romania publishes no separate national healthy-volunteer template. Explain the absence of therapeutic benefit, investigational status, dose escalation and uncertainty for first-in-human trials, and the practical burden (admissions, fasting, restrictions, blood volume, contraception, confinement in a Phase I unit). Payment amounts or calculation logic and timing match the compensation form. Phase I or bioequivalence: the unit needs ANMDMR authorisation (RO-N-PHASE1).

Representative consent plus the minor's agreement, mandatory when the minor can form an opinion and assess the information (Order 3390/2022). No fixed assent age bands in Romania: the template bands are readability bands. Explicit refusal or withdrawal of a capable minor is respected. Re-consent as an adult at 18. Only expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation. A paediatrician is part of the investigator team.

Representative document always; adapted participant information where the participant can understand some information. Where the participant can form an opinion and assess the information, both the participant and the representative sign the informed-consent form (Order 3390/2022). Representative authority verified under Romanian law. Re-consent with the adult document if capacity returns.

Only when every Article 35 condition is met and the trial directly relates to the emergency condition. Subsequent consent without undue delay from the participant or representative, whichever can validly give it first; known prior objection respected; no promise to delete data already collected under Article 35. Add the legal-representative or witness pathway where it applies.

Only for a participant who can consent but cannot write. Not a substitute for a legal representative. The witness signs and dates the consent document; the physician conducting the interview also signs and dates.
Dedicated Romanian follow-up document when maternal, pregnancy-outcome or infant information beyond the main consent is collected. Romania has no national pregnancy template.

Dedicated Romanian document for a pregnant partner asked directly for health, pregnancy-outcome or infant information or record access. The participant's consent does not cover another person's data. The partner is not described as receiving trial treatment or benefit.

Only for genuinely optional future use; research required by the protocol stays in the main document. Separate choice or clearly separated signature section so the main trial can be accepted without the future research. Representative versions where minors or adults lacking capacity are included.

drafting_rules: Participant documents in Romanian, in plain Romanian suitable for the intended population, with no unexplained scientific abbreviations; translations complete, not only the signature page. Non-participant documents may be in English (Government Emergency Ordinance 29/2022).
Use the supplied Romanian templates as the baseline; keep the model text where it fits, add every study-specific detail and remove every drafting instruction and non-applicable module.
Describe the process actually planned at Romanian sites, not generic wording.

The consent interview is conducted by a physician who is a member of the investigation team and appropriately trained on the protocol and GCP (Order 3390/2022); reflect this in the physician's declaration and signature block.

Blank ICF with the correct signature blocks for every planned pathway: participant or legally designated representative and the physician; impartial witness signs and dates where the participant cannot write; participant and representative both sign for an adult lacking capacity who can form an opinion and assess the information.

Distinguish consent to participate from the legal basis for processing personal data; do not present trial consent as the only legal basis, and do not promise deletion of data or samples where legal or scientific retention applies.
Optional choices (future use, additional procedures) clearly optional, each with a separate choice and signature; integral protocol procedures are not labelled optional.

Compensation and insurance wording match the national compensation form and the insurance evidence; for minors, adults lacking capacity and pregnant or breastfeeding participants only expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.
Recruitment material in Romanian, consistent with K1, with no claims beyond the protocol; electronic recruitment resources need prior CNBMDM approval.
Every document carries protocol number, country, language, version and date; no tracked changes, hidden comments or placeholder text.

Participant templates (JSON): italic text, [square-bracket] notes, 'Instrucțiune pentru autor' passages and '...........' or '____' gaps are drafting instructions or gaps; follow and remove them, except consent-visit fields that stay blank. Part II templates (DOCX): yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels. Nothing of either may remain in a final document.

sources.RO-TEMPLATES: CTIS_RO folder: RO_12 participant-facing templates_09082026.txt (split into templates/participant), shared Part II DOCX forms, Variable Templates_RO_de.xlsx

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.romania_note: CTCG pattern with country RO and language ro where they distinguish the document; always kept for participant-facing documents (_RO_ro). The Romania guides name no CTIS titles. The national recruitment form name 'RO_Procedura de recrutare şi obţinere a consimţământului informat' is not used as a CTIS title: K1 follows the naming guide. Next free N number for the Phase I unit authorisation; proof of payment uses the CTIS Forms section. Drop <population> when the study has one population. Personal names only for the principal investigator in M1/M2.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section from a participant template, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, training provider, site, legal). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru adolescent (12–17 ani) și acord privind participarea la studiul clinic
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and agreement for adolescents (readability band 12-17)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Children
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru copil și acord privind participarea la studiul clinic
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and agreement for children (readability band 6-11)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving children participants (aged 6 - 11 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Emergency Enrolment and Deferred Consent Form
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații privind înrolarea în situație de urgență și consimțământ informat ulterior pentru continuarea studiului
participant_templates.role: information and consent to continue after emergency enrolment
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves emergency enrolment before prior informed consent because neither the participant nor a legal representative can provide consent within the required treatment window.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Healthy Adults
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru voluntarul sănătos și formular de consimțământ informat pentru participarea la studiul clinic
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving healthy adult participants (18 or older without a specific health condition). Can be used for non-treated participants when no other template applies.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Legal Representative
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru reprezentantul legal și formular de consimțământ informat pentru participarea persoanei reprezentate
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the legal representative of an adult lacking capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves adult participants who cannot provide informed consent and participation must be authorised by a legally authorised representative.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Limited Capacity
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații adaptate pentru participantul adult cu capacitate limitată / Exprimarea voinței privind participarea
participant_templates.role: adapted information and expression of will for the adult lacking capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult lacking consent capacity who retains sufficient understanding to receive adapted information and express assent, willingness or objection. It accompanies the legal representative’s consent.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adult Patients
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru participant și formular de consimțământ informat pentru participarea la studiul clinic
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (capable adult patients)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adult patients (18 or older & diagnosed with a specific health condition). Can be used for patients when no other template applies such as re-consent after reaching adulthood, regained capacity, prescreening, or optional substudies or extension arms.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Parents
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru părinte/reprezentant legal și consimțământ informat pentru participarea minorului
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the parent or legal representative of a minor
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving minor participants (younger than 18 years).

participant_templates.name_ro: Informații și consimțământ pentru urmărirea sarcinii – participantă însărcinată
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from a pregnant trial participant.

participant_templates.name_ro: Informații și consimțământ pentru urmărirea sarcinii – partenera însărcinată a participantului
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the pregnant partner of a participant
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from the pregnant partner of a male trial participant.

participant_templates.name_en: Secondary and Future Use of Data or Biosamples
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații și consimțământ pentru utilizarea secundară sau viitoare a datelor și probelor biologice
participant_templates.role: optional secondary or future use of data or samples
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves optional storage or secondary use of participant data, biological samples or genetic material beyond the mandatory purposes of the main clinical trial.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Impartial Witness
participant_templates.name_ro: Informații pentru participant și consimțământ informat în prezența unui martor imparțial
participant_templates.role: consent with an impartial witness for a capable participant unable to write
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult participant who has capacity to consent but cannot read, write or sign the standard consent form. The participant decides personally, while an impartial witness confirms and documents the consent process.
participant_templates.use_note: The template's description also mentions a participant who cannot read or sign; the Romania guide and Order 3390/2022 trigger the witness route when the participant can consent but cannot write. Planned only in that case (templates/README.md, conflict 2).

population_rules.authority: Ministry of Health Order 3390/2022 (Articles 14 and 15, Annex 3) and CNBMDM, as recorded in the Romania guides reviewed 23 September 2026; Romanian Civil Code (full legal capacity normally at 18; joint parental authority); Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35.

minors.band_rule: Order 3390/2022 publishes no fixed CTIS-specific assent age bands; information is adapted to age and mental maturity. The template bands 6-11 and 12-17 are readability bands, not legal thresholds; capacity to form an opinion and assess the information is assessed individually.
minors.band_conflict: None: the authority sets no band, so the supplied bands are kept and no file is renamed.
minors.agreement: The minor's agreement is mandatory, in addition to the legally designated representative's consent, when the minor can form an opinion and assess the information. The explicit wish of such a minor to refuse or withdraw is respected.
minors.representative: Parental authority is generally joint and equal; verify who has legal authority in the individual case rather than assuming a particular family member can sign.
minors.reconsent_at_18: RO-PT-main or RO-PT-healthy: new informed consent before further protocol-related actions when the participant reaches 18 (normal age of full legal capacity). Do not build the routine pathway on the Civil Code exceptions (marriage, court-recognised capacity from 16) unless the participant's legal status is confirmed.
minors.under_6: No template. The guide says a short child information or assent document may be appropriate for younger children (DECISIONS.md D4).
minors.team: A paediatrician is part of the investigator team when the trial involves the paediatric population (operational; checked in N1 and M1).
minors.payment: No financial inducement beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.

adults_without_capacity.signature_rule: Where the participant can form an opinion and assess the information, both the participant's and the representative's signatures on the informed-consent form are mandatory (Order 3390/2022); the representative's form keeps the participant block, and RO-PT-limited-capacity documents the adapted information and the participant's will.
adults_without_capacity.regained_capacity: RO-PT-main: the participant is re-informed and asked to consent to continued participation.
adults_without_capacity.payment: No financial inducement beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.
adults_without_capacity.note: Combine with the impartial-witness pathway if the participant cannot write. A relative does not automatically have legal authority.

emergency.note: Subsequent consent from the participant or the representative, whichever can validly give it first. If the participant lacks capacity beyond the emergency, apply the limited-capacity pathway; if the participant cannot write, the witness pathway.

impartial_witness.note: Capable participant unable to write. The witness signs and dates the consent document. Not combined into a minor or limited-capacity pathway; apply those in addition where they apply.

healthy_volunteers.note: Phase I or bioequivalence units need ANMDMR authorisation (RO-N-PHASE1).

pregnancy.note: Participant document only where data beyond the main consent are collected; partner document whenever the partner is asked directly for information or record access.

population_rules.non_romanian_speakers: Plan translated information and consent documents for any non-Romanian-speaking population the protocol and sites are expected to enrol; K1 explains how valid consent is obtained.
population_rules.shareable_note: May be one shared document for several populations when nothing in it would differ; agree with the user. Secondary-use consent for minors and adults lacking capacity follows the population's consent giver, so separate versions may be needed.
separate_document_rules: Optional future use of samples or data: separate choice or clearly separated signature section, so the main trial can be accepted without the future research; the supplied templates use a separate document (RO-PT-secondary). Do not label integral protocol research optional.
A pregnant partner asked directly for information receives a dedicated document; the participant cannot consent for the partner.
Each genuinely optional activity has its own YES/NO choice, signature and date (supplied templates).

population_sets_note: population_sets list which templates a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents.
answer_languages_note: Single package language: Romanian. Participant documents Romanian only; forms answered in Romanian (English permitted for non-participant documents, DECISIONS.md D1). Translated participant sets for non-Romanian speakers are extra languages of the same package, not separate packages.
